_: THE KIT. docs/WELCOME.md §1. A packing list, not a tutorial — hints and nods from someone who has played this before. Nothing here describes a feature of Tari except the first two cards, which earn the exception because they are the argument for the rest (TARI.md §2.3). `icon` is a file under public/kit/, or an absolute path when the art already lives somewhere else. Kacey's copy to redline.

cards.subject: The other screen
cards.tag: Why this doesn't run in the game
lines: This doesn't run inside the game, on purpose.
An addon sits in the corner of your eye and you follow it without ever taking your hands off the keys — which is how people arrive at 60 having seen nothing.
Tari costs you a look away. That second, where your character stands still in the world while you read something, is the whole product.

cards.subject: The addon only listens
cards.tag: It is a sensor, never a display
lines: It tells Tari where you're standing.
Tari never tells you where to go.

cards.subject: A fishing pole
lines: Cheap, and every lake in the world becomes somewhere to sit for ten minutes.
Nobody has ever regretted the ten minutes.

cards.subject: Bait
cards.tag: And the patience to use it
lines: Shiny Bauble, five silver, twenty minutes of better luck.

cards.subject: One empty bag slot
lines: For the thing you keep because it's strange, not because it sells.

cards.subject: A hearthstone somewhere you like
lines: The one you'd want to wake up in.

cards.subject: Somewhere to sit
lines: Basic Campfire is level 1 cooking and nobody ever takes it.

cards.subject: A lap
cards.tag: The rares are not likelier to drop anything
lines: Every zone has rares walking it. They aren't likelier to drop anything good — that's the point.
Kill two or three on a slow circuit and one of them hands you something you'd never have known existed.
The upgrade isn't the reward. The afternoon is.

cards.subject: The quest text
lines: Twelve murlocs is twelve murlocs either way.
Reading why is the difference between playing Azeroth and clearing it.

cards.subject: Leave something
lines: Everything anyone knows about a place in here was left by somebody who stopped.
You don't need to know anything yet to start.
